description: This file defines an interface ILivenessTestGrain within the namespace UnitTests.GrainInterfaces. The interface declares asynchronous methods related to a grain's label, runtime instance ID, unique ID, obtaining a grain reference, and starting a timer.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label associated with the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Obtains a reference to the grain itself.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer related to the grain.
